brief: My team needs to find the next customer to call, record the call and move on.
attendee_facts: Calls must not be duplicated across the team.

question.q: What happens after a call is recorded?
question.a: The next unassigned customer should appear.

agent_assumption: Two people sometimes call the same customer.
why_this_path: guided ideation is evaluated on ambiguous problems
consistency: settled questions are not asked again
the same brief and stage survive an agent switch
